provisional_outcome: Store the provenance and record whether immune-deficient status was indicated on the laboratory request. Unknown or unlisted combinations require clinician review.
source_document: NCSP immune-deficiency guidance v1.0.1, 12 Mar 2026
implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.
